params.name: recursive
params.description: Delete a folder and everything in it.

label: Download file
description: Send a file to the helper. Files over 8 MiB need offset and length.

params.name: offset
params.description: First byte to send, counting from 0. Setting offset or length sends one part of the file.

params.name: length
params.description: Bytes to send in this part, up to 4 MiB.

label: Create directory
description: Create a folder and any missing parents.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path of the new folder.

label: Upload file
description: Write a file sent by the helper.
